newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks firm, led by brewing, insurance.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks firm, led by brewing, insurance.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged up slightly Friday, led by brewing and insurance which announced strong profit rises in 1996.
Bogota's IBB index gained 0.41 percent to close at 1,069.02 amid a 3.1 billion peso trade. Medellin's IBOMED general price index was up 0.15 percent at 16,812.3 amid a thin 896 million pesos volume.

One Bogota trader said demand was fueled by brewing giant Bavaria's announcement that year-end net profits were up 18.9 percent. Its shares gained 1.71 percent to close at 6,888 in Bogota and was up 0.41 percent to 6,980 in Medellin.

Insurance company Suramericana de Seguros, part of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate, posted a rise in year-end net profits of 16.4 percent. It was up 0.67 percent in Bogota to 22,300 but was not traded in Medellin.

The U.S. decision to blacklist Colombia for a second consecutive year for its failure to crack down hard enough on drug trafficking was announced after the close of the session but caused little uncertainty during the day's trade, brokers said.
